entries.name: claude-mem
entries.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 7,623 star（日均约 1,089，相对存量增速 6.8%），累计 112,580 star、9,784 fork。窗口内被 fork 618 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，327 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 7,623 stars over the last 7 days (~1,089/day, 6.8% of its base), now at 112,580 stars and 9,784 forks. 618 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 327 contributors.

intro.zh: 给 AI 编程助手装上跨会话记忆：自动记录 agent 每次会话做了什么，用 AI 压缩成语义摘要，下次会话再把相关上下文注入回去。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Copilot 等工具，装一次就能让 agent 记住项目来龙去脉，不用每次重新交代背景。
intro.en: Gives your AI coding assistant persistent memory across sessions: it automatically captures what your agent does, compresses it with AI into semantic summaries, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and more — install once and your agent remembers the project without you re-explaining.

cardLine.zh: 给 AI 编程助手装上跨会话记忆，自动记录、压缩并回注上下文。
cardLine.en: Persistent cross-session memory for AI coding agents: capture, compress and re-inject context.

highlights.zh: 自动捕获会话中的工具使用与决策，压缩成语义摘要存档。
highlights.en: Automatically captures tool usage and decisions during sessions, compressing them into semantic summaries.

highlights.zh: 新会话自动注入相关上下文，agent 不用每次重新熟悉项目。
highlights.en: Relevant context is injected into new sessions, so agents don't re-learn your project every time.

highlights.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Copilot 等多种 agent 工具。
highlights.en: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and many other agent tools.

highlights.zh: 记忆提供方可自选：托管服务、自己的 OpenRouter/Gemini key 或 Anthropic 计划。
highlights.en: Pick your memory provider: the hosted service, your own OpenRouter/Gemini key, or your Anthropic plan.

entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,784 star（日均约 826，相对存量增速 5%），累计 115,185 star、7,278 fork。窗口内被 fork 420 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，469 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,784 stars over the last 7 days (~826/day, 5% of its base), now at 115,185 stars and 7,278 forks. 420 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 469 contributors.

intro.zh: 一个专门管理 agent 车队的桌面工作台：把 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等编程 agent 并排跑起来，每个都在独立的 git worktree 里干活，统一在一个界面追踪。手机上也能监控遥控，agent 干完活还会推送通知。适合同时开好几个 agent 干活的开发者。
intro.en: A desktop workbench for running a fleet of coding agents: run Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and more side-by-side, each in its own git worktree, all tracked in one place. Monitor and steer from your phone, with notifications when agents finish. Built for developers juggling multiple agents at once.

cardLine.zh: 编程 agent 编排工作台，多 agent 并行跑在独立 worktree 里统一管理。
cardLine.en: An orchestrator workbench that runs coding agents side-by-side in isolated worktrees.

highlights.zh: 一条 prompt 同时发给五个 agent，各自在隔离 worktree 干活，比较结果择优合并。
highlights.en: Fan one prompt across five agents, each in an isolated worktree, then compare and merge the winner.

highlights.zh: 手机端随时监控 agent 进度，任务完成即推送，可远程发后续指令。
highlights.en: Monitor agents from your phone — get notified on completion and send follow-ups from anywhere.

highlights.zh: 内置 GitHub 和 Linear 视图，从任务直接开 worktree，评审不用切窗口。
highlights.en: Native GitHub and Linear views: open a worktree from any task and review without context switching.

highlights.zh: 点击真实浏览器里的 UI 元素，把 HTML、CSS 和截图直接塞进 agent 提示词。
highlights.en: Click any UI element in a real Chromium window to send its HTML, CSS and screenshot into the agent's prompt.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,162 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,162 open issues — high relative to its star count

intro.zh: 一个让编程 agent 有审美的技能包：接到需求先定艺术方向、找真实图片素材，再在真实浏览器里检查页面效果，而不是套模板生成千篇一律的 AI 落地页。基于对 247 个精选网站的研究，装进 Claude Code 或 Codex 后，一句 brief 就能产出有设计感的页面。
intro.en: An agent skill that gives coding agents taste: it picks an art direction, sources real images, and checks its own work in a real browser instead of assembling generic AI landing pages. Built from a study of 247 curated sites — install into Claude Code or Codex and hand it a brief.

cardLine.zh: 给编程 agent 装上审美：定艺术方向、配真实图片、浏览器自检页面。
cardLine.en: Gives coding agents taste: art direction, real images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages.

highlights.zh: 基于 247 个精选网站的研究，从 20 个设计方向中抽三个供 agent 挑选。
highlights.en: Built from a study of 247 curated sites; deals three of 20 researched directions for the agent to pick.

highlights.zh: 自动从开放图库找真实照片并标注来源，拒绝千篇一律的 AI 素材。
highlights.en: Finds real photographs from open archives and credits them, instead of generic AI-looking assets.

highlights.zh: 在真实浏览器里按三种宽度检查页面，不合格就修，最多三轮。
highlights.en: Checks the page in a real browser at three widths and fixes the top problems, up to three rounds.

entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,964 star（日均约 709，相对存量增速 2.7%），累计 184,303 star、10,167 fork。窗口内被 fork 381 次，最近一次提交在 6 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 190 个、issue 200 个，132 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,964 stars over the last 7 days (~709/day, 2.7% of its base), now at 184,303 stars and 10,167 forks. 381 new forks in the window; last push 6 day(s) ago; 190 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 132 contributors.

intro.zh: 把最懒的资深工程师塞进你的 AI agent：原则是能不写的代码就不写。要个日期选择器？别的 agent 装 335 行的库，它先看仓库里已有的组件和浏览器原生能力，10 行搞定。官方基准显示代码量、耗时、成本都明显下降，但该有的测试和安全检查一个不少。
intro.en: Puts the laziest senior dev inside your AI agent: write only what the task needs. Ask for a date picker and instead of installing a 335-line library, it combines the repo's existing components with the browser's native one in 10 lines. Benchmarks show less code, time and cost — without cutting tests or security.

cardLine.zh: 让 agent 学会「最懒资深工程师」思维：只写必要的代码，不堆功能。
cardLine.en: Makes your agent think like the laziest senior dev: write only the code the task needs.

highlights.zh: 官方基准：耗时、成本、token 分别下降 41%、26%、45%，代码更精简。
highlights.en: Benchmarks: 41% less time, 26% less cost, 45% fewer tokens, with leaner code.

highlights.zh: 98% 的高风险逻辑带测试交付（不用时仅 68%），安全任务 30 次全过。
highlights.en: 98% of risky logic ships with a test (vs 68% without), and all 30 security-task runs passed.

highlights.zh: /ponytail-review 不只看 diff，还读改动涉及的代码，给出具体修复建议。
highlights.en: /ponytail-review reads the code your change touches, not just the diff, and says how to fix each finding.

highlights.zh: /ponytail-audit 先梳理仓库入口和数据流，再按优先级排序该修什么。
highlights.en: /ponytail-audit maps entry points and data flow first, then ranks what to fix.

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,306 star（日均约 615，相对存量增速 3%），累计 142,268 star、13,600 fork。窗口内被 fork 499 次，最近一次提交在 1 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，369 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,306 stars over the last 7 days (~615/day, 3% of its base), now at 142,268 stars and 13,600 forks. 499 new forks in the window; last push 1 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 369 contributors.

intro.zh: 在 AI 编程助手里输入 /graphify，它会把整个项目——代码、文档、SQL schema、PDF——解析成可查询的知识图谱，让你用提问代替翻文件 grep。代码解析用 tree-sitter AST 在本地完成，确定性、不调 LLM、数据不出机器，每条边都标明是直接提取还是推断。
intro.en: Type /graphify in your AI coding assistant and it maps your entire project — code, docs, SQL schemas, PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph, so you ask questions instead of grepping files. Code is parsed locally with tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, nothing leaves your machine, and every edge is labeled extracted or inferred.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库变成可查询的知识图谱，用提问代替翻文件找代码。
cardLine.en: Turns any codebase into a queryable knowledge graph — ask questions instead of grepping files.

highlights.zh: 代码用 tree-sitter AST 本地解析，不调 LLM、数据不出机器。
highlights.en: Code is parsed locally with tree-sitter AST — no LLM, nothing leaves your machine.

highlights.zh: 每条关系都标注 EXTRACTED 或 INFERRED，直接读到的和推断的分得清。
highlights.en: Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED, so direct reads and inferences are clearly separated.

highlights.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 20+ 助手，跨平台可用。
highlights.en: One install works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and 20+ more assistants.

highlights.zh: 文档、PDF、图片、视频也能进图谱，语义关联一并建好。
highlights.en: Docs, PDFs, images and video go into the graph too, with semantic connections built in.

entries.name: OpenMontage
entries.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

cardLine.zh: 开源 agentic 视频制作系统，一句话让编程助手跑完整个制作流程。

highlights.zh: 12 条制作流水线、100+ 工具、700+ 技能与知识文件。

highlights.zh: 官方示例短片成本可低至 1.33 美元，含脚本、配音、字幕和配乐。

entries.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

intro.zh: 给 AI agent 装上看全网的眼睛：一条命令让 agent 能搜小红书、读 B 站字幕、查雪球行情、翻 Reddit 和 Twitter——这些登录墙后、视频里、中文平台上的内容，普通 CLI agent 基本够不着。零 API 费用，装好即用，还能按需添加可选平台。
intro.en: Gives your AI agent eyes on the whole internet: one command lets it search XiaoHongShu, read Bilibili subtitles, check Xueqiu quotes, and browse Reddit and Twitter — content behind login walls, inside videos, or on Chinese platforms that CLI agents normally can't reach. Zero API fees, works out of the box.

cardLine.zh: 一条命令让 agent 够到全网：中文平台、登录墙内容、视频字幕都能读。
cardLine.en: One CLI gives your agent the whole internet: Chinese platforms, login-walled content, video transcripts.

highlights.zh: 默认支持 B 站、GitHub、YouTube、V2EX、网页搜索，装好就能用。
highlights.en: Bilibili, GitHub, YouTube, V2EX and web search work by default, right after install.

highlights.zh: 小红书、雪球、Boss 直聘等中文平台，一句话按需开启。
highlights.en: Add Chinese platforms like XiaoHongShu, Xueqiu and Boss just by asking.

highlights.zh: YouTube 字幕和播客语音转文字，视频内容也能进 agent 上下文。
highlights.en: YouTube subtitles and podcast speech-to-text bring video content into the agent's context.

highlights.zh: 登录用独立后台浏览器，不碰你的主浏览器和密码库。
highlights.en: Logins run in a dedicated background browser — your main browser and password vault stay untouched.

entries.name: paperclip
entries.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 2,509 star（日均约 358，相对存量增速 2.3%），累计 111,029 star、18,384 fork。窗口内被 fork 465 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，235 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 2,509 stars over the last 7 days (~358/day, 2.3% of its base), now at 111,029 stars and 18,384 forks. 465 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 235 contributors.

intro.zh: 一个开源的 AI agent 管理平台：如果说 OpenClaw 是员工，Paperclip 就是公司本身。用 Node.js 服务加 React 界面编排一队 agent，定业务目标、分角色、设预算，在仪表盘里追踪进度和成本。适合同时开二十个 Claude Code 终端却记不清谁在干嘛的人。
intro.en: An open-source platform for managing AI agents at work: if OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company. A Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of agents — assign business goals, roles and budgets, then track progress and costs from one dashboard. For anyone running twenty Claude Code terminals and losing track.

cardLine.zh: 开源 agent 编排平台：定目标、分角色、控预算，像管公司一样管 agent。
cardLine.en: Open-source agent orchestration: assign goals, roles and budgets — manage agents like a company.

highlights.zh: 兼容 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等，能收心跳的都能「入职」。
highlights.en: Works with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more — if it can receive a heartbeat, it's hired.

highlights.zh: 内置组织架构、预算管控和治理机制，agent 自主运转可审计。
highlights.en: Built-in org charts, budgets and governance keep autonomous agents auditable.

highlights.zh: 像任务管理器一样用：定目标、组团队、审批后放手让 agent 干。
highlights.en: Feels like a task manager: define the goal, hire the team, approve, then let agents run.

highlights.zh: 支持自定义进程、HTTP 端点和适配器扩展，手机上也能管理。
highlights.en: Extensible via custom processes, HTTP endpoints and adapters — manageable from your phone.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 6,590 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 6,590 open issues — high relative to its star count

fitFor.zh: 探索多智能体协作、角色分工与复杂流水线编排的架构师
fitFor.en: Architects exploring multi-agent collaboration, role assignments, and pipeline orchestration

fitFor.zh: 需要网页自动化操作、跨系统流程 RPA 或数据采集的工程师
fitFor.en: Engineers requiring web browser automation, cross-system RPA, or web data extraction

fitFor.zh: 要把 Agent 能力嵌进自己产品的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product
